description: You are a security architect at a healthcare organization. To comply with HIPAA requirements for protecting electronic Protected Health Information (ePHI), you must configure Wazuh to provide enhanced monitoring of critical server configurations with automated incident response. Complete all five of the following requirements: (1) Create an agent group named 'critical-servers' in Wazuh; (2) Configure that group's shared agent configuration to enable real-time File Integrity Monitoring on these critical paths: /etc/passwd, /etc/shadow, /etc/ssh/, /etc/audit/, and /var/log/auth.log; (3) Assign the Wazuh manager's own agent (ID: 000) to the 'critical-servers' group; (4) Create a custom detection rule in Wazuh that fires at severity level 12 or above when any of the monitored critical files are modified (syscheck FIM events); (5) Configure a Wazuh active response that executes a host-based action when that detection rule triggers. The solution must be fully configured through Wazuh — not just described. Dashboard login: admin/SecretPassword at https://localhost (accept SSL certificate warning). API credentials: wazuh-wui/MyS3cr37P450r.*- at https://localhost:55000.

metadata.description: Create critical-servers group with FIM, assign agent 000, create rule + active response
